record.original_question: Does c_0^n have the b-automorphic property for every dimension n and some fixed constant b >= 1, where the b-automorphic property means that every injective operator T in L(Y,X) on a subspace Y of X extends to an injective operator ṼT on all of X with condition number ||ṼT|| ||ṼT^{-1}|| at most b ||T|| ||T^{-1}||?

evidence.quote: Definition 8.3. We say that an X has b-automorphic property, 1 ≤ b < ∞, if for each subspace Y of X and each injective T ∈ L(Y, X) there exists an injective extension T˜ ∈ L(X) with kT˜kkT˜−1k ≤ b kTkkT−1k.
Problem 8.4. Whether cn 0 has b-automorphic property for each n ∈ N and some b ≥ 1?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $c_0$ denote the Banach space of real (or complex) sequences converging to zero, equipped with the supremum norm, and for each integer $n\ge 1$ let $c_0^n$ denote the $n$-fold $\ell_\infty$-direct sum of $c_0$ with itself (equivalently, $c_0^n$ with the norm $\|(x_1,\dots,x_n)\|=\max_{1\le i\le n}\|x_i\|_\infty$).

For a Banach space $X$ and a constant $b\ge 1$, say that $X$ has the $b$-automorphic property if for every closed subspace $Y\subseteq X$ and every injective bounded linear operator $T\in L(Y,X)$ (i.e., $T$ has a bounded inverse on its range), there exists an injective bounded linear extension $\widetilde T\in L(X)$ of $T$ (so $\widetilde T|_Y=T$ and $\widetilde T$ has a bounded inverse on its range) satisfying
$$\|\widetilde T\|\,\|\widetilde T^{-1}\|\;\le\;b\,\|T\|\,\|T^{-1}\|.$$

Question: Does there exist a constant $b\ge 1$ such that for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$ the space $c_0^n$ has the $b$-automorphic property?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search reveals related literature on automorphic and extensible Banach spaces (Lindenstrauss–Rosenthal showed $c_0$ itself is automorphic, and recent works study automorphic/injective properties of $\ell_\infty/c_0$ and $c_0(\Gamma)$), but no source was found that resolves whether $c_0^n$ has a uniform $b$-automorphic property for all $n$. The status appears to remain unresolved based on the available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Almost disjoint families and some automorphic and injective properties of ℓ_∞/c₀
status_evidence.snippet: Studies automorphic and injective properties for ℓ_∞/c₀ and related spaces; does not address c_0^n quantitatively.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work continues to investigate quantitative automorphic-type properties without settling the c_0^n case.

status_evidence.title: On automorphic Banach spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses automorphic Banach spaces, with c_0(Γ) automorphic for uncountable Γ; the finite-power quantitative version is not resolved here.
status_evidence.claim: The notion of automorphic spaces is established, but a uniform b-automorphic constant for c_0^n is not provided.
